user.title: Connect to Aero NVR
user.description: Generate a token in Aero under Settings → Add-ons → Home Assistant, then paste it here.

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.50:2525, or a full https:// URL.
data_description.token: Shown once when you generate it in Aero.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to Aero NVR
reauth_confirm.description: Aero rejected the saved token. Generate a new one under Settings → Add-ons → Home Assistant.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Aero at that address.
error.addon_missing: The Home Assistant add-on is not installed in Aero. Add it under Settings → Add-ons.
error.unsupported_version: This Aero server speaks a different integration API version. Update Aero or this integration so the two match.
error.wrong_server: That token belongs to a different Aero server.

abort.already_configured: This Aero server is already set up.
